tone.target: jangly edge-of-breakup indie blues with light tube grit
tone.profile: jangly edge-of-breakup indie blues with light tube grit
tone.summary: A Fender/Deluxe style chain using a Boost for initial brightness, followed by the US Deluxe amp model, paired with a US 2x12 cab. Subtle reverb and EQ are used to achieve the desired jangly, airy indie blues sound.
